answer: The toll is £49 in fees and a 5-day delay before the stamp dries per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. One name, one proof, one entry: Sworn tinsmith quarry seal enforces it, and a seal smiths carry after solder hearings is how the check runs. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Every quill is counted once. One ripple, one entry. The clerk notes willow.
